scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w admin-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w admin-web
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-fallen
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fallen --only auth,firestore,storage "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts"
scripts.format: prettier --write functions/src admin-web/src tools tests docs *.json *.ts *.mjs
